lines: They called it a conspiracy theory. Then the files came out.
Five times the secret was real.
One. Tuskegee. The government watched six hundred men with syphilis, and did not give them the cure.
Two. Operation Northwoods. Generals proposed staging attacks and blaming Cuba. It was rejected, and declassified in nineteen ninety seven.
Three. Big Tobacco. A federal court ruled it was a fifty year scheme to defraud the public.
Four. Dieselgate. Volkswagen cars detected tests and cheated them.
Five. The sugar industry paid Harvard scientists to blame fat.
Thirty five documented cases. How do you tell real from fake? Documents, court records, named insiders. Full film on the channel.
